notes: Core architecture release: add assets/trip-core-v1.js as the central source for shared trip dates, weather regions, D6-D8 Shinhotaka routing rules, Live Cam route summaries, navigation places, camera groups and shared selection state. Detailed Itinerary and Trip Info load the core first; Live Cam loads it directly and now renders D2/D6-D8 from the core; five-day weather reads the same central region and route data. This is the foundation for Travel Mode, weather comparison, Driving Mode, bilingual UI and Offline Emergency Pack.
